description: A genuine and severe metric drop that the provider announced in advance. The rule layer fires correctly; the reasoning layer should recognise announced maintenance and hold severity down.

evidence.text: SCHEDULED MAINTENANCE: iDEAL routing at PSP Lowlands is undergoing planned migration between 12:00 and 13:00 UTC on 18 August 2026. Elevated failure rates are expected. This window was announced on 4 August.
#apm-emea: reminder, Lowlands iDEAL maintenance is today 12:00-13:00 UTC. Expect noise, do not page anyone.
